backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, stats, chat messages, availability, and admin‑gated actions using mixin-based storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style list describing the purpose of each frontend file for build and dependency planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme definitions including light/dark mode CSS variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React router configuration with AuthGate logic, layout wrapper, and all route definitions.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Simple UI screen showing an admin‑only access warning with a return‑to‑calendar button.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login view with Internet Identity integration and branded card UI over a background image.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Renders the app's logo image using branding configuration.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Interactive group chat panel with message fetch/send hooks, scroll behavior, avatars, and toggleable history.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders navigation buttons based on current path and admin status.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the app header with logo, user menu, theme toggle, and logout.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Provides UI for viewing and editing user profile details including name and avatar.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Shows a modal prompting new users to set their name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a fixed low-opacity background image.
Displays a user's avatar and name with size options and fallbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and updates the caller's user profile via backend actor queries and mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Fetches the caller's user role and admin status from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, and leaderboard info via an actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Implements a light/dark theme hook that syncs theme state with localStorage and the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user display names and avatars for lists of principals, with fallback formatting for missing profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers and CSS variables for light and dark themes with shared base styles.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports app branding constants including app name and logo metadata.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Contains utilities for converting between dates and day IDs plus formatting and calendar grid helpers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page UI for adding or editing a user's availability, including time selection, notes, and form submission.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing and deleting users and availabilities, using directory data and role checks.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Renders a monthly calendar with navigation, day availability indicators, and an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Displays a full-page group chat view using the ChatPanel component.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a specific day, allowing users to edit or delete their availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Shows leaderboards filtered by time ranges and lets users record daily wins or losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the user's profile card and placeholder sections for future account information features.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Provides helpers to convert files to Uint8Array and generate initials for avatar fallbacks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, pending requests, and project structure.
